---
title: "Grid Layout"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
extensions:
  photo-gallery:
    album-files: img
    layout: grid
    columns: 5
    gap: 4
    show-bullets: true
---

The **grid** layout uses CSS Grid with uniform square cells and `object-fit: cover` — all thumbnails are the same size regardless of the source image's aspect ratio. Good for portfolios where visual consistency matters more than showing full frames.

## 5-column grid with dot navigation

With `show-bullets: true`, the PhotoSwipe lightbox shows a dot indicator at the bottom. Click any image to see it:

{{< photo-gallery >}}

## Minimal gallery — no metadata, no download

Use shortcode arguments to strip the gallery down for contexts where you want clean presentation without any UI chrome. `show-exif=false` hides camera data, `show-download=false` removes the download button from the lightbox toolbar, and `transition="none"` disables the open/close animation:

```markdown
{{</* photo-gallery img/ columns=5 show-exif=false show-date=false show-download=false show-bullets=false transition="none" id="minimal" */>}}
```

{{< photo-gallery img/ columns=5 show-exif=false show-date=false show-download=false show-bullets=false transition="none" id="minimal" >}}
